name: Squarespace
one_liner: E-commerce website builder whose Commerce APIs manage orders, products, inventory, and transactions.
auth_notes: API key generated in site Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys, or OAuth 2.0 access token. Both are scoped to one website. OAuth requires Squarespace Extensions.
access_notes: API keys for a custom application require the Commerce Advanced plan (price not stated on fetched pages). OAuth needs client registration that is reviewed and approved, and Extensions for OAuth.

buildability.rationale: Public REST Commerce APIs with API key or OAuth access, but custom-app API keys need the Commerce Advanced plan and OAuth needs client approval.

identity.quote: Get deep control with Commerce APIs, Reseller APIs, and a reliable custom code spec.

auth.quote: Then, depending on your development needs, authenticate requests by using an API key or OAuth access token.

access.quote: With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
Registering an OAuth client, and having it reviewed and approved, only allows OAuth connections with Squarespace.

api_surface.quote: Subscribe to order, inventory, content, and customer events with signed delivery.

mcp.quote: A Squarespace MCP server lets AI agents work with Squarespace data through the Model Context Protocol

needs_human_reason: Commerce Advanced plan price and OAuth client review timeline are not stated on the fetched pages; no official MCP server found.
